topic: Defining dwell time KPIs for facility data
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on correcting and differentiating dwell time calculations for mall facilities. It was noted that the current calculation method, which summarizes data if multiple sensors see a device simultaneously, is incorrect.

It was proposed to establish two distinct Key Performance Indicators (KPIs): 
1. Screen dwell time: The total time spent across several screens.
2. Location dwell time: The overall time spent within the mall facility.

The implementation of these KPIs will be visible only for the Master Facility.
decisions: Implement two distinct KPIs: Screen dwell time and Location dwell time.
